problem.title: Append Characters to String to Make Subsequence
problem.problemStatement: Given two strings S and T, determine the minimum number of characters that must be appended to S so that T becomes a subsequence of S.
problem.input: • First line contains string S. • Second line contains string T.
problem.output: Print the minimum number of appended characters.
